en: The front side of this postcard displays a colorized photograph of a coastal landscape with a rocky shoreline, a sandy beach in the foreground, and a prominent building with a dome and spire on the hill overlooking the sea. The background text is in three languages: Bulgarian, Russian, and French, identifying the location. The card has handwritten notes and postal marks including a stamp from Varna. The reverse side has handwritten text in Cyrillic, indicative of communication, a postal stamp from Varna, and recipient details.
